scripts.dev:docker: docker run --name body-builder-journal --rm --volume="jekyll-gems:/usr/local/bundle" --volume="$PWD:/srv/jekyll" -p 4000:4000 -it jekyll/jekyll sh -c "bundle check || bundle install && bundle exec jekyll serve --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build:docker: docker run --name body-builder-journal --rm --volume="jekyll-gems:/usr/local/bundle" --volume="$PWD:/srv/jekyll" -it jekyll/jekyll sh -c "bundle check || bundle install && bundle exec jekyll build"
